nina (product): Announcing preview: Private syslog/CEF export for VPC & on-prem customers. Opt-in preview starts Mon 2026-05-04 for one week.

nina (product): Purpose: let customers forward structured infra and audit logs to their SIEM (syslog, CEF) without sending raw telemetry to Redwood. Useful for compliance & enterprise monitoring.

leo (eng-sre): Tech summary: export connector runs in the customer's network boundary (sidecar or daemonset). It consumes events from the staging audit index and emits syslog/CEF to customer endpoints. TLS + mTLS supported.

tara (eng-security): Security note: connector never ships customer plaintext outside their network. We sign exports with ephemeral creds and include `export.preview` tag in records. Must enable egress allowlist in the VPC.

ria (customer-success): Customer ops: we'll invite 5 pilot customers (those asking for SIEM integration). I'll draft invite & install guide. Also prepare a runbook for failover back to Redwood retention if export fails.

jordan (legal): We need sample export contracts + data flow diagrams for pilot customers. Also confirm retention defaults and opt-out mechanics.

nina (product): Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha w/ infra & security (May 4), 2) 5-customer invite-only preview (May 5-8), 3) feedback window & tweak (May 9-10), 4) GA decision May 18.

leo (eng-sre): Quick install snippet for pilots: `kubectl apply -f https://git.internal/redwood/syslog-export/preview/daemonset.yaml` and then configure `EXPORT_TARGET=syslog://siem.example.com:514` in secret.

tara (eng-security): Pilot checklist: enforce admin MFA, enable SIEM cert pinning, rotate connector creds after each onboarding. We'll provide a sample cert pinning config.

ria (customer-success): I'll ask pilots to validate event mapping (CEF fields) and confirm SIEM parses auth/audit events correctly.

deploy-bot: Preview connector image pushed: `redwood/syslog-export:preview-20260504` -> registry.private.redwood (status: pushed).

nina (product): Action items: - eng-sre: publish install guide + sample CEF mapping (leo) - eng-security: deliver cert pinning & checklist (tara) - legal: export sample clause & diagrams (jordan) - customer-success: pilot invites (ria).

leo (eng-sre): I'll post the install guide and mapping file to the docs space today.

nina (product): Thanks team. If you see any blocker, ping me. Will share pilot list tomorrow. :satellite:
